name: EASE traveler pre-registration
summary: Cape Verde runs entry through EASE, an online traveler pre-registration portal. Fees, who must register and stay length were not confirmed.

other: Register on the EASE portal at ease.gov.cv before arrival
Fee and exact rules not confirmed from the official page

name: Entry and transit visa for listed nationalities
summary: From January 1, 2026, nationals of countries on a list published on ease.gov.cv must get an entry visa, and a transit or airport stopover visa, before arriving. Without it, entry, transit or stopover may be refused. Apply at the nearest Cape Verde embassy. The country list was not read.

other: Applies only to nationalities on the official PDF list on ease.gov.cv
Apply through the nearest Cape Verde embassy
